scope: Three seen training songs; exact cached derived 4K labels, not acoustic truth or unique correct composition. Failed outputs are partial diagnostics.

definitions.onset_matching: Existing maximum-cardinality/minimum-error monotone assignment, 50ms; full note F1 additionally requires lane and type.
definitions.exact_group: Same lane+type multiset at matched onset; excludes Hold duration. Denominator: matched onsets.
definitions.four_group: Four consecutive reference onset groups reproduced with exact lane+type and consecutive predicted indices; all reference four-group windows in denominator, excludes Hold duration.
definitions.patterns: Existing singleton-only four-onset geometry; chords interrupt; no rhythm threshold or musical-quality quota.
definitions.hold_conflicts: Any later same-lane onset strictly inside a Hold; near-touch Hold pair means endpoint gap absolute <=10ms. Descriptive, not a feasibility verdict.
definitions.dense_tap_patterns: Additional diagnostic subset: singleton Tap only, chords and other types break chains, adjacent gaps <=0.5 beat +10ms tolerance. Not a universal gameplay definition, quota or original benchmark change.
